author: Tabletop Minions
description:
In this video, I explain miniature scales in wargaming and why they're not as important as you might think. We'll look at how to measure them and discuss the different aspects of scale model considerations in this tabletop hobby. This is essential knowledge for anyone involved in miniature painting or collecting plastic models.
